saby.review:
Faculty review: SaBy (Shehreen Bhuiyan Amin) 
Course: Wms201 (Gender and Development Studies)
A very sweet and charm person, talks very dearly to her students. Teaches very nicely and goes in depth of the topic. Her lectures are pretty lengthy usually, so it is really hard to keep concentration. She explains every topic with examples, more like with the aspects of Bangladeshi issues. So, it really gets easy to understand the topics easily.
Strategies: She takes three quizzes (of which best two counts), one mid-term, one assignment (individual) and a final. Her question pattern is very tricky. In case you wanna pull out the best, you really have to go through the study materials. 
Personal experience: Got an A following all the instructions she provided. Thank you 
Peace! 
 See less

SaBY is love.
Rarely came across a faculty as sweet as her and the way she enjoys her own stories while narrating them is too adorable. Not a boring minute at her class.
You have to study & mark uthano aktu tough if u don't put efforts,

ktr.review: I took wms201 under ktr miss last sem. It was one of the most easiest courses. Also mam was extremely friendly and fun! The course teaches simple topics like gender, feminism and others which are easy to grasp as we already know about it. Miss didn't give much Pera regarding attendence. I missed a few classes but got full marks. The course has a few projects which are fun but some might find them extra burden. For example one project was to click pictures of a topic that was given to us and present those pictures In front of everyone. It was fun.
